sourceThread.title: 设计舞台装置卡牌类型框

constraints: 保持原版竖向卡身、名称飘带和效果区
回合数字居中位于箭矢类型铭牌上方
回合数字与类型文字分层考虑，概念稿采用连体铭牌
当前为视觉候选，尚未接入工作台或游戏

variants.name: 箭镞
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: selection-stage concept for the new Arrow card TYPE frame in a Slay the Spire 2 Junna mod.
Reference image 1 is a REAL in-game comparison of four card types, not an illustration to copy wholesale. Use it as the PRIMARY authority for proportions, texture, painted bevels, spacing, typography and native visual weight. The LEFTMOST card is the approved Stage Device frame, with its turn numeral directly above the type-name plaque. The other three demonstrate native Attack, Skill and Power shapes. Create ONE NEW Arrow-type full card and a cropped detail of its type-and-count assembly, not the four reference cards.
DESIGN INVARIANTS:
The full card keeps the native tall 598:844 rectangular footprint, modest clipped outer corners, slender ochre-gold outer card body, curved silver-grey title ribbon with folded pointed tails, separate small faceted energy badge at upper left, subdued warm dark grey-brown paper rules panel below. Match the reference's FLAT hand-painted 2D game UI finish: broad simple bevel planes, light brush grain, very restrained wear. The portrait border, name ribbon and type plaque are COMMON-RARITY neutral silver-grey. Treat gold only as the unchanged outer-body style reference, not as an ornamental portrait border.
The Arrow TYPE identity must be expressed chiefly through the silhouette of the portrait window and its restrained border geometry. Preserve most of the illustration area and all the ordinary rules text area. The type label stays at the SAME fixed native height, centered at the portrait/rules boundary, approximately y=460 on the original 844-pixel card; its position is independent of the new window outline.
MANDATORY TIMER LAYOUT: A large readable cream numeral "2" is directly ABOVE the small type plaque labeled "箭矢", with both on the same centerline and connected as a modest one-piece silver-grey plaque. The numeral sits within the portrait's lower center and the lower plaque retains the native type-label baseline. The counter must NEVER move to the top-right, energy badge, title ribbon, or rules panel. This assembly is compact, similar to the approved leftmost reference. Only numeral and type text, no clock, loop arrow, hourglass, sublabels or words describing turns.
COMMON SAMPLE CONTENT, exactly the same for every variant:
Title on ribbon: "JA13".
Energy numeral: "1".
Turn numeral: "2".
Type plaque: "箭矢".
Rules text, centered in the lower panel: "造成16点伤害。".
Illustration: broad softly painted teal and dark turquoise silhouettes of a stage archer girl drawing a bow toward the right beneath pale stage beams. Keep illustration subdued and secondary to the frame. Do not add fine character detail or extra symbolic props.
SHEET COMPOSITION:
Landscape canvas around 1536x1024, quiet near-black green-grey background. On the LEFT show exactly ONE complete large upright card, roughly 900 pixels high, fully visible with modest margins. On the RIGHT show ONLY an enlarged cropped cutout of that SAME count-and-type plaque plus a little adjoining portrait border, for readability. The enlargement must match the card exactly. Add only the single variant letter above the card in small unobtrusive cream type. No other explanatory copy, dimension labels, arrows, swatches, desktop UI, orb, extra cards, visual states, watermark or logos.
AVOID: bulky equipment casing, 3D-rendered chrome, jewelry, excessive ornament, multiple border rings, screws, giant arrow props, feathers glued around the whole card, piercing the title, busy scratches, altering native outer-body proportions or making the type assembly huge.

VARIANT A — LANCEOLATE ARROWHEAD WINDOW.
The portrait aperture has a broad gently rounded top beneath the ribbon, subtly chamfered upper shoulders, and long gently sloping lower flanks converging into a distinct centered lower arrowhead point. The lower edge is a slim elongated leaf-like lance point, neither the native Attack's shallow straight V nor the Stage Device's rounded flat bottom. Make the center point terminate just BEHIND the compact type plaque, with the timer rising above it. The border is a continuous thin silver-grey painted bevel with a crisp restrained tip and smooth upper shoulder transitions. Counter housing: a low pointed ogive crown smoothly joined to the rectangular type tab, echoing an arrowhead at small scale. Preserve the fixed label baseline and spacious rules panel. Variant letter: "A".
